description_en: Creates a credential in a specified workspace for agent authentication when accessing external services. Currently, only the apiKey type is supported. The credential content is passed in as a JSON string through credentialMetadata and can only be queried in masked form after being written
description_zh: 在指定工作空间内创建凭证，用于智能体访问外部服务时的鉴权。当前仅支持 apiKey 类型，凭证内容通过 credentialMetadata 以 JSON 字符串传入，写入后只能以脱敏形式查询
name: CreateCredential

fields.help_en: The credential content. The value is a JSON string. When credentialType is set to apiKey, the JSON string can contain only the apiKey field, and the value cannot be empty. After being written, the content can only be queried in masked form
fields.help_zh: 凭证内容，取值为 JSON 字符串。credentialType 为 apiKey 时只能包含 apiKey 一个字段，且取值不能为空。写入后仅支持脱敏查询
fields.name: credential_metadata

fields.help_en: The credential type. Currently, only apiKey is supported
fields.help_zh: 凭证类型。当前仅支持 apiKey
fields.name: credential_type

fields.example: 线上环境调用模型服务使用的 API Key
fields.help_en: The credential description. The description can be up to 256 characters in length
fields.help_zh: 凭证描述，长度不超过 256 个字符
fields.name: description

fields.help_en: The credential name. The name must be unique within the workspace and can contain only letters, digits, periods, underscores, and hyphens. The name must be 3 to 128 characters in length and cannot use runtime reserved names
fields.help_zh: 凭证名称。在工作空间内唯一，只能包含字母、数字、点、下划线和连字符，长度为 3~128 个字符，且不能使用运行时保留名称
fields.name: name

parameters.help_en: The request body for creating a credential
parameters.name: body

createdAt.description_en: The creation time in UTC, formatted in RFC 3339
createdAt.description_zh: 创建时间，采用 RFC 3339 格式的 UTC 时间

credentialMetadata.description_en: The masked credential content. When credentialType is apiKey, the apiKey value is returned as asterisks (*) of equal length
credentialMetadata.description_zh: 凭证内容的脱敏结果。credentialType 为 apiKey 时，apiKey 的取值以等长的 * 返回

credentialType.description_en: The credential type. Currently, only apiKey is supported
credentialType.description_zh: 凭证类型。当前仅支持 apiKey

description.description_en: The credential description. The description can be up to 256 characters in length
description.description_zh: 凭证描述，长度不超过 256 个字符
description.example: 线上环境调用模型服务使用的 API Key

name.description_en: The credential name. The name must be unique within the workspace and can contain only letters, digits, periods, underscores, and hyphens. The name must be 3 to 128 characters in length and cannot use runtime reserved names
name.description_zh: 凭证名称。在工作空间内唯一，只能包含字母、数字、点、下划线和连字符，长度为 3~128 个字符，且不能使用运行时保留名称

regionId.description_en: The region ID of the resource

updatedAt.description_en: The time of the last modification in UTC, formatted in RFC 3339
updatedAt.description_zh: 最近一次修改的时间，采用 RFC 3339 格式的 UTC 时间

message.description_en: The response message. An error description is returned if the request failed
message.description_zh: 响应消息。请求失败时返回错误描述

success.description_en: Indicates whether the request was successful
